forms:
<$voicel(3,10)><$emotion(3,27)>Whoa! Now this is a surprise!
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,805)>When I saw the town all lit up, I figured the humans had
finally come back...
<$voicel(3,3)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,806)>But you Pokémon got the town glowin’ again all
by yourselves?

<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>Talk about a SHOCKIN’ development! I <$voicel(3,10)><$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,816)>even let loose an
extra-large lightnin’ bolt—that’s how shocked I was!
<$voicel(3,4)><$comeff(3,14)><$textsize(0)>And, uh, if it hit anyone...my bad.

<$voicel(3,4)><$emotion(3,29)>Y’know, I’m not really sure where all the humans went.
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,666)>With big bad natural disasters happenin’ all over the place,
I guess they ran off somewhere safe.
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,806)>As for this town in particular, those huge clouds were
keepin’ it super dark all the time, right?
<$voicel(3,5)>Humans can’t live without sunlight, y’know!
<$voicel(3,3)><$comeff(3,7)><$motion(3,663)>By the time I realized what was goin’ on, this place was
already a ghost town...

<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,666)>Looks like my awesome lightning cleared out those nasty
clouds, though!
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,806)>Maybe the humans’ll come back when they realize the
clouds are gone?

<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,14)>Anyway, I think I’m gonna head out! Tell your friends I
said, “What’s up!” <$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,8)>I’m best buds with ALL of you now!

<$cdef(27)>Raikou, the Thunder Pokémon, has been registered in
your Pokédex...
Your Trainer rank increased to <$cdef(27)><$dtrnrank;0(3)>!

<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>Catch ya later, bud! Hope we can hang out next time our
paths cross!

<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,899)><$cdef(27)>! Did that Pokémon happen to
be <$cdef(27)>Raikou?

<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,659)>Oho, so I was right! It’s quite astonishing that a Legendary
Pokémon would appear in this town as well!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,806)>What an impressive lightning strike that was! I’d expect
nothing less of <$cdef(27)>Raikou!

<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,660)><$facial(1,9)>Hmmm, natural disasters, you say?
<$voicel(1,3)>Now that you mention it, all the land I saw before I met
you was terribly ruined... <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>What in the world happened?

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh! How could I forget?! It seems <$cdef(27)>Snorlax is unharmed.
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>What an incredibly tough Pokémon!

<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>But, oh dear... It looks as if they’re stunned and cannot
move due to the lightning.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,659)><$facial(2,5)>Could you try talking to them for us,
<$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>Try talking to <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color>, would you?
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,659)><$facial(2,5)>Could you try speaking to <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color>?

It seems like there’s still more for you to do in
<$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(2)>.
<$voicel(3,4)><$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,666)>Somethin’ seemed a li’l...shockin’ just now...

<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,16)><$motion(3,839)>*yaaawn*
Sure was a nice nap I jus’ had, though.
... ... ...
... ... ...
<$voicel(3,6)><$motion(3,656)><$comeff(3,15)>Wouldn’t hurt to sleep a li’l more, I s’pose...
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,7)>Hey, now! Haven’t you slept enough?!
<$voicel(3,4)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)>Hmmm? Who are y’all s’posed to be?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>You were sleeping here long enough to be completely
covered in moss, <$cdef(27)>Snorlax! Why, some other Pokémon
even took to calling you <$cdef(27)>Mosslax because of it!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,663)>We were quite worried that you would get weaker and
weaker, sleeping away without anything at all to eat, so
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)>we all worked together to wake you!
<$se2d(1092)>*GRRLLLGRRMMMBLLL*

<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,666)>Oh... Now that ya mention it, I am a li’l hungry.
... ... ...
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,6)>Ya reckon I lost some weight?

...<$cdef(27)>Mosslax, huh? S’pose that describes me well enough.
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(3,9)><$emotion(3,27)>So, uh...y’all pretty much saved me, huh? <$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,49)>That sure was a
nice thing to do! Thank ya kindly!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,827)>Listen, <$cdef(27)>Mosslax, do you remember anything about what
happened before you fell asleep?
<$voicel(1,4)>Do you know where the humans went?<$motion(1,654)>

<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,666)>Hm? I don’t remember a whole lot, but—wait, the humans
are gone?!
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,7)>Well, that ain’t good... They gave me food!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)>Oh? Does that mean you <$voicel(1,8)>lived in harmony alongside
the humans?

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,3)>Sure did! Y’know how there’re naughty Pokémon out there
who like to play tricks on folks?
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>Well, I’d run those Pokémon off, and the humans would
gimme food in return—<$comeff(3,5)>Ah! <$voicel(3,10)>I jus’ remembered somethin’!
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,14)>At some point, I stopped gettin’ as much food as I
used to!
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,666)>Seems the humans had run low on food themselves...

<$comcan(3)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>I wonder if those natural disasters <$cdef(27)>Raikou mentioned had
anything to do with that?

<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,661)>Eventually, I started to get kinda hangry, and I scuffled
with a real ornery-lookin’ Pokémon, thinkin’ I might let
off some steam...
<$voicel(3,4)><$comeff(3,14)>But I got whupped soundly! <$voicel(3,6)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,666)>And that frustrated me so bad
I figured I’d jus’ sleep it off.
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,9)>You seem a tad dangerous yourself.

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,899)>My goodness! Do you mean to say you were buried in the
dirt and covered in moss because...<$voicel(2,4)>you took a nap?<$motion(2,657)>

<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>Huh... Yeah, I s’pose that’s what happened. Can’t say I
really remember it all that well, though.

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>So the humans were struggling as a result of natural
disasters...
So much so that they didn’t have enough food...
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Then where did they go after that?

<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,8)>I dunno, but I sure am grateful to y’all for savin’ me!
Keep in touch now, y’hear!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>Say, <$cdef(27)>, there seems to be another
gate
in
this
town,
apart
from
the
one
we
came
in through.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Now that you’ve registered <$cdef(27)>Raikou in your Pokédex, you
may be able to pass through it!

<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)>I think you should go check it out when you’re ready.
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)>And I’ll be coming with you, of course!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, and remember that <$cdef(27)>sand-covered building we found
on the beach in <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(1)>?
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>Something about that keeps tugging at my mind as well.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I’d appreciate it if you could check on it every now
and then.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Thanks to you, this town has gotten much livelier—<$voicel(1,8)>and of
course much brighter!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>If you’d like to explore somewhere you haven’t been
before, I recommend heading back to the previous town
<$voicel(1,5)>and going through that other gate there.

<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)>And whenever you do, you can be sure I’m coming
with you!

<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)>Let’s do our best to brighten up the town! We must find a
way to wake up <$cdef(27)>Snorlax!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,659)>Even small Pokémon can live an enjoyable life in this town!
The thought alone fills me with such joy.

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,661)>You’re skilled at so many things, <$cdef(27)>.
I am
quite envious!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>You’re always transformed to look like your
Trainer, <$cdef(27)>.
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>They must have been someone very important to you.
